metadata.description: Nine Claude Code plugins, each with commands that prove its claims: QA, design audit, security, AWS costs, writing, long tasks, loops, explainers, agent docs.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Walks your running app in a real browser and lists what is broken: dead pages, console errors, broken forms. Each page bug comes with repro steps and a fix.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: ESLint for design. Reads your CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind, then names the file, line, measured wrong value and fix. WCAG 2.2 contrast, no dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Turns a topic or your git session into one HTML explainer. Double-click to open, works offline, no JavaScript. One file to attach or send.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Ranks what to cut on your AWS bill, three cuts first. Each cut is priced from AWS at run time; a priced finding without its lookup record is rejected. Dry-run by default.

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Hand off a big task once. goalify asks its questions up front, writes the plan and the /goal finish line. Its verify step re-runs your tests into a receipt.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Names the 55 habits that make text read as AI-written and rewrites it in one of five voices you pick, with an optional 0 to 100 score. No network calls of its own.

plugins.name: loopify
plugins.description: Writes the brief and the one line for Claude Code's /loop. One status command reads the tick log and says OK, NEEDS YOU or STALE.

plugins.name: secure-my-app
plugins.description: Runs 65 security checks on your app before launch. Each hole comes with its proof, and a fix counts only when the VERIFY command shows the change.

plugins.name: contextify
plugins.description: Know when your agent instructions point at something gone. One AGENTS.md for all your agents and a local check that costs no tokens.
